yourPDF · Good to know

A little help. A lot less friction.

Start with the task

Choose a tool on the homepage. Select a file or use the built-in sample. Settings appear only after a file is selected. Merge and image-to-PDF support multiple files; other tools use one PDF.

Page selection and ordering

For extraction and splitting, enter ranges such as 1, 3-5, or tap page previews. Remove pages marks pages to delete. Organize PDF keeps selected pages; left/right buttons change output order. Blank ranges mean all pages where allowed; Remove pages requires an explicit choice.

Limits

PDF tasks: up to 20 files, 30 MiB combined and 150 pages. PDF-to-JPG: up to 40 selected pages, with the longest image edge capped at 2,000 pixels and a 100 MiB combined image-output limit. Images-to-PDF: up to 20 still images, 24 MP per image, 30 MiB total. Images are flattened onto white, capped to 2,400 pixels on the longest side and JPEG-encoded at a 92% setting, then placed on A4 pages.

Browser support

Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. PDF preview uses PDF.js, and image tasks require worker canvas support. Complex PDF rendering may fail on low-memory devices. Preview is not a security audit; do not treat a processed PDF as sanitized.

Optimization is not a guarantee

Structural optimization can reduce some PDFs. It does not resample images or guarantee a requested KB target. If the new file is not smaller, the original is offered with a clear message.

Document fidelity

Page-copy tools may not preserve outlines, forms and all document-level features. Any edit may invalidate a digital signature. Watermark text supports basic Latin characters; page numbers are placed in page coordinates and may need review on already rotated pages. Keep originals and inspect outputs.

Not included yet

Office conversion, OCR, e-signature workflows, password encryption/decryption, text editing, redaction and advanced compression are not included. If a tool fails on your device, try its sample file and report the browser version and error through ContactDownload helpLicenses.
